Guide to Migration and Security on Exchange 2007 for SMBs
Sponsored by: Sunbelt Software
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Deploying Exchange Server can be especially tough on small and
medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Outside of the normal challenges that
come with deployment, SMBs also have to deal with smaller budgets and
a limited IT staff.

This eGuide provides information and techniques that SMBs can use
when deploying Exchange Server to improve cost effectiveness and
availability. Topics covered include:

** Exchange Server deployment strategies for SMBs
** A primer on Exchange 2007 server role

Click here to download this eGuide:
http://go.techtarget.com/r/3143697/2079970

Exchange Server 2007: Mailbox Role Memory Characterization Using HP
BladeSystem
Sponsored by: HP
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
Since its introduction, Microsoft Exchange has been a very disk I/O
intensive application. With the introduction of Exchange 2007, there
were significant changes to the Exchange architecture; one in
particular is the transition from a 32-bit platform (x32) to the
64-bit (x64). This allowed for significant increases in available
memory resources for the application, allowing memory to scale well
beyond the 4GB available to Exchange 2003. By increasing database
cache, larger portions of the user's mailbox can now be cached,
reducing the I/O on disk.

This paper demonstrates the benefits of additional system memory in
the HP ProLiant BL480c blade realized through mailbox memory
configuration testing and also details other performance
considerations when working with larger memory configurations.
